title: MCX / MMC JSON Input

oneOf.title: Debug flags
oneOf.description: Debug flags as letters: mcx/mcxcl R (RNG), M (photon moves), P (progress bar), T (trajectories only); mmc also accepts its own letters (see mmc --help), e.g. T for timing; or the equivalent integer bit mask

oneOf.title: Save detected photon flags
oneOf.description: D: detector ID, S: scattering counts, P: partial paths, M: momentum transfer, X: exit position, V: exit direction, W: initial weight, I: Stokes vector

OutputFormat.title: Output file format
OutputFormat.description: mc2/nii/jnii/bnii/hdr/tx3 for mcx and mmc grid output; ubj (mcx); ascii/bin (mmc mesh output)

OutputType.title: Output data type
OutputType.description: the -O letter (x flux, f fluence, e energy, j Jacobian/wl, p nscat/wp, m momentum, r RF, l length (mcx) or wl (mmc), s RF mus, t wltof, b wptof, a/d/u/v/w/q adjoint types), or the name mcxlab/pmcx/mmclab/pmmc use

BCFlags.title: Boundary conditions
BCFlags.description: Up to 6 letters for the -x/-y/-z/+x/+y/+z facets (_: default, r: Fresnel, a: absorbing, m: mirror, c: cyclic), optionally followed by 6 digits (0/1) to enable photon detection at each facet

RayTracer.title: Ray tracer (MMC mesh domains only)
RayTracer.description: g: dual-grid DMMC (default; voxel volume output like MCX, forces BasisOrder 0), s: branchless Badouel (mesh output: values on nodes when BasisOrder=1, on elements when BasisOrder=0). On GPU workers p/h/b silently fall back to s

BasisOrder.title: Fluence basis order (MMC mesh domains only)

RootPath.title: Output folder
RootPath.description: folder the output files are written to (default: the current folder)

Checkpoints.title: Checkpoints (mmc)
Checkpoints.description: photon counts at which mmc saves intermediate results

N0.title: Exterior refractive index (MMC mesh domains only)
N0.description: Refractive index of the medium outside the mesh

Omega.title: RF modulation angular frequency (mmc, rad/s)
Omega.description: 0 = CW. mmc reads the frequency-domain modulation here, in rad/s; mcx and mcxcl read Optode.Source.Frequency in Hz instead

Pos.title: Position
Pos.description: A single [x,y,z] or [x,y,z,weight] vector, or an array of such vectors to launch multiple sources simultaneously; Pos/Dir/Param1/Param2 arrays must have matching lengths

Dir.title: Launch Direction
Dir.description: A single unitary vector [vx,vy,vz] with an optional 4th element (focal length; "_NaN_" enables launch-angle mode), or an array of such vectors for multiple sources

Param1.title: Source Parameter 1
Param1.description: Source-type-specific parameters [p1,p2,p3,p4]; an array of such vectors sets per-source parameters when launching multiple sources

Param2.title: Source Parameter 2
Param2.description: Additional source-type-specific parameters [p1,p2,p3,p4]; an array of such vectors sets per-source parameters when launching multiple sources

ID.title: Source ID (0: launch all together, -1: save each source separately, >0: launch a single source)

AngleInverseCDF.title: Launch-angle inverse CDF
AngleInverseCDF.description: A monotonically increasing vector with values between 0 and 1, defining the inverse CDF of the launch zenith angle (x1 in x1*pi)

Frequency.title: RF modulation frequency (mcx/mcxcl, Hz)
Frequency.description: 0 = CW. mcx and mcxcl read the frequency-domain modulation here, in Hz; mmc reads Forward.Omega in rad/s instead

Pos.title: Position
Pos.description: [x,y,z] or [x,y,z,r], r the radius when R is not given

MieScatter.title: Mie scatterers (polarized MC)
MieScatter.description: Per-medium spherical-particle properties for polarized photon simulations; requires Optode.Source.WaveLength

InverseCDF.title: Scattering-angle inverse CDF
InverseCDF.description: A monotonically increasing vector with values between -1 and 1, defining the inverse CDF of a user-specified scattering phase function (cosine of the scattering angle)

AngleInverseCDF.title: Launch-angle inverse CDF (mcx)
AngleInverseCDF.description: samples of the inverse cumulative distribution of the launch zenith angle

oneOf.title: Tetrahedral mesh (mmc)
oneOf.description: the mesh given under Shapes instead of Mesh; mmc accepts either place

MeshID.title: Mesh file ID
MeshID.description: reads node_<MeshID>.dat, elem_<MeshID>.dat and, when present, facenb/velem files

InitElem.title: Initial element
InitElem.description: 1-based index of the element enclosing the source; 0 or negative to let mmc find it

LengthUnit.title: Length unit (mm)
LengthUnit.description: length of one mesh coordinate unit in mm

MeshNode.title: Mesh nodes
MeshNode.description: Tetrahedral mesh vertices, one [x,y,z] coordinate per node

MeshElem.title: Mesh elements
MeshElem.description: Tetrahedra as [n1,n2,n3,n4,tag] rows: four 1-based node indices plus a region tag indexing Domain.Media

MeshSurf.title: Mesh surface (OptiX)
MeshSurf.description: boundary triangles as [n1,n2,n3,inner label,outer label] rows (int32, N x 5)

MeshROI.title: Implicit MMC regions
MeshROI.description: per-element (or per-node/edge) ROI radii or thicknesses for implicit MMC (single)

_ArrayType_.description: element type: integer labels, single for continuous media (per-voxel mua/mus/g/n), uint64 for packed formats (svmc, asgn_byte, ...)

_ArraySize_.description: [Nx,Ny,Nz], or [Nx,Ny,Nz,K] with K property values per voxel (K = 2 or 4 for continuous media)

Mesh.title: Mesh (mmc)
Mesh.description: the tetrahedral mesh of an mmc simulation: either MeshID naming mesh files (node_<ID>.dat, elem_<ID>.dat, ...) or MeshNode and MeshElem embedded here; ignored by mcx and mcxcl

MeshID.title: Mesh file ID
MeshID.description: reads node_<MeshID>.dat, elem_<MeshID>.dat and, when present, facenb/velem files

InitElem.title: Initial element
InitElem.description: 1-based index of the element enclosing the source; 0 or negative to let mmc find it

LengthUnit.title: Length unit (mm)
LengthUnit.description: length of one mesh coordinate unit in mm

MeshNode.title: Mesh nodes
MeshNode.description: Tetrahedral mesh vertices, one [x,y,z] coordinate per node

MeshElem.title: Mesh elements
MeshElem.description: Tetrahedra as [n1,n2,n3,n4,tag] rows: four 1-based node indices plus a region tag indexing Domain.Media

MeshSurf.title: Mesh surface (OptiX)
MeshSurf.description: boundary triangles as [n1,n2,n3,inner label,outer label] rows (int32, N x 5)

MeshROI.title: Implicit MMC regions
MeshROI.description: per-element (or per-node/edge) ROI radii or thicknesses for implicit MMC (single)

description: One input format for mcx, mcxcl (voxel domains) and mmc (tetrahedral meshes). A voxel domain is given by Shapes (shape commands or a JData volume) or Domain.VolumeFile; a mesh domain by Mesh (or the mesh form of Shapes). Fields marked (mcx) or (mmc) are read by that program only. Domain may be omitted by mmc, which then reads the media from prop_<MeshID>.dat.
